title: fix(lint): one-line fix lines for the 11 validate-widget-bindings rule ids (slice 17); `os explain RULE_ID` carries what they explained
body:
Part of #22161
Clause-②: no

Slice 17 of the card: the over-long `fix:` lines, continued in slices 11 to 16's shape, for the whole-file slice `packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts`. Each finding's `hint` (the CLI's `fix:` line, the runtime issue's `hint`) of the 11 rule ids in that file whose hint ran past 200 characters is now one remedy line of at most 200 characters, and what the lines used to explain is each id's `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` entry behind `os explain RULE_ID`. The card stays open: other author-time ids still carry a hint over 200 characters (the last section).

Claim: `6180782552` (newest `Claim:` on the card, naming this branch; verified before the first edit).

## What changes

- **One remedy line per finding.** The 11 ids, every hint the lint suite fires, before → after (count of distinct hints · length range), all measured with the same census preload as slices 15 and 16, at the base `086fa4640` and at this head:

| rule id | lint suite, before → after | runtime door (`dashboard` write) |
|---|---|---|
| `dashboard-filter-field-unprovisioned` | 3 · 551–561 → 2 · 175–177 | 2xx advisory |
| `chart-field-unknown` | 5 · 299–415 → 5 · 125–152 | 2xx advisory |
| `dashboard-filter-field-unknown` | 10 · 185–403 → 6 · 139–148 | 422 |
| `chart-measures-missing` | 2 · 252–369 → 3 · 100–144 | 2xx advisory |
| `widget-legacy-analytics-shape` | 1 · 338 → 2 · 112–113 | 2xx advisory |
| `widget-measures-missing` | 8 · 307–330 → 9 · 131–154 | 2xx advisory |
| `widget-filter-field-unknown` | 3 · 211–322 → 1 · 133 | 422 |
| `widget-legacy-analytics-unrenderable` | 1 · 320 → 1 · 105 | 422 |
| `table-count-only` | 1 · 311 → 1 · 136 | 2xx advisory |
| `chart-dimensions-missing` | 1 · 291 → 1 · 161 | 2xx advisory |
| `dashboard-filter-field-not-included` | 1 · 218 → 1 · 144 | 422 |

The base maxima equal the claim's lengths id for id (561, 415, 403, 369, 338, 330, 322, 320, 311, 291, 218). A count that falls is a list that no longer makes each hint distinct; a count that rises is a case this slice added (a five-measure dataset, a dataset with no measures, a one-key legacy widget).

- **Lists are no longer echoed** (slices 11, 12, 14 and 16's rule):
  - `dashboard-filter-field-unknown` and `widget-filter-field-unknown` no longer append the object's field list (`account.detail` on the dotted arms, `Object fields:` on the bare arms). The verdict's "Did you mean" names the nearest field on the dotted arms; the bare dashboard-filter arms keep their own "Did you mean" after the remedy.
  - `dashboard-filter-field-not-included` no longer lists the dataset's declared `include` paths: the remedy names the one to add.
  - **One bounded clause stays**: the three empty-selection ids (`chart-measures-missing`, `widget-measures-missing`, `chart-dimensions-missing`) have no "Did you mean" to point at, so they still name what the dataset declares, bounded to the first three names and then an ellipsis (a new local `declaredFew()`), or "it declares no measures yet". This is a deviation from a bare remedy, stated so the reviewer can rule on it.
- **The reasoning moves, the remedy stays.**
  - The suppression clause leaves every warning's fix line; each entry already carried it, and the two new entries carry it too (slice 14's `unconsumed-widget-option` precedent).
  - `dashboard-filter-field-unprovisioned` now prints the shared one-line `unprovisionedAnchorFix()` the other anchor ids print, and its entry gains the shared `UNPROVISIONED_ANCHOR_REMEDY` paragraph (`columnMap`, `ownership: 'none'`, `systemFields: { audit: false }`); the widget's `filterBindings` opt-out and the suppression were already in the entry.
  - The two field-existence ids' entries gain a "to fix it" paragraph: a dotted re-target or filter key must traverse relationship fields (lookup, master_detail, user or tree), its prefix must be in `include`, and the verdict's "Did you mean" names the nearest field.
  - `chart-field-unknown`'s entry gains what replaces each refused key (x-axis from the first dimension, y-axis bindings one per mark from `values`, series membership from `values` and a second dimension to split) and the house `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence, which left the x-axis hint.
  - The three empty-selection entries say the `fix:` line names up to three declared names.
- **Two ids gain an `os explain` entry**, so their `rule:` line now carries the pointer: `table-count-only` (why a count-only, dimensionless table renders one summary row; that a flat record listing is an object-bound ListView, ADR-0017; the suppression) and `widget-legacy-analytics-shape` (the cutover's removed keys, that DatasetWidget reads only the dataset, that strict parse preempts the rule on `compile` / `validate`, the suppression). Both ids already had a rule id constant on the root barrel (`TABLE_COUNT_ONLY`, `WIDGET_LEGACY_ANALYTICS_SHAPE`), so no published name is added and `Clause-②: no` holds. Seven existing entries gain text; none is removed.
- **Nothing else moves.** Every `message`, rule id, severity and `path` is unchanged, and so is what the rule accepts or refuses. Every hunk in the rule file is a `hint` expression, a comment, the new `declaredFew()` helper, the removed `datasetHint` / `suppressHint` / `fixHint` / `shapeHint` locals, and the import swap `unprovisionedAnchorHint` → `unprovisionedAnchorFix` (the long form is still used by two other rule files).

### File surface: the claim's

The claim (`6180782552`) names `validate-widget-bindings.ts` and its tests, `rule-explanations.ts` (entries for these ids only), the consumer tests that pin these hints' text, and `.changeset/22161-s17-*.md`. The diff is exactly four paths: those two source files, the one test file, and `.changeset/22161-s17-widget-binding-fix-lines.md`. The one shared-text edit outside the eleven entries is the docblock of `UNPROVISIONED_ANCHOR_REMEDY`, which now lists `dashboard-filter-field-unprovisioned` among its users.

**Pin sweep, repo-wide** (examples and docs included): `git grep` for each id, its constant and every distinctive old hint phrase. The only files pinning these hints' text are in `validate-widget-bindings.test.ts`; `examples/app-showcase/test/dashboard-filter-vocabulary.test.ts`, `runtime-gate.test.ts`, `validate-chart-bindings.test.ts`, `validate-react-page-props.test.ts` and `metadata-protocol`'s `protocol.runtime-gate-stored-universe.test.ts` name the ids but read no hint of them; no docs transcript quotes one. So no `packages/cli` or `packages/metadata-protocol` rider was needed. Each flipped pin asserts the new text exactly, or the fact it still carries (the dimension clause on a measureless chart, the `'metric' or 'kpi'` alternative, the declared names), plus the absence of the moved list.

## The runtime wire

All 11 run at the runtime publish gate: `validateWidgetBindings` is `CLI_AND_RUNTIME` with `runtimeTypes: ['dashboard']`. Measured at the door with `runRuntimeAuthoringRules`, a scratch probe of 15 `dashboard` writes run against the base rule sources and the branch's:

- 422 `issues[].hint`: `widget-legacy-analytics-unrenderable` 320 → 105; `dashboard-filter-field-unknown` 196 / 195 / 290 → 148 / 147 / 137 (an inherited bare field, a re-targeted bare field, a dotted path); `dashboard-filter-field-not-included` 213 → 139; `widget-filter-field-unknown` 220 → 126.
- 2xx `advisories[].hint`: `widget-legacy-analytics-shape` 338 → 112; `dashboard-filter-field-unprovisioned` 550 → 173; `chart-field-unknown` 413 / 294 / 324 → 150 / 124 / 127 (x-axis, y-axis, series); `chart-measures-missing` 240 → 96; `widget-measures-missing` 310 → 134; `chart-dimensions-missing` 297 → 156; `table-count-only` 311 → 136.

Readers of `hint`, read-only against the local objectui checkout at `b434f5f47`: `saveAdvisoryToast.ts` prints an advisory's hint after its message, so the seven advisories shorten in Studio's save toast; `DraftChangesPanel.tsx` reads `hint` only for its in-browser security-posture pass; no source reads a 422 issue's `hint`. REST forwards `issues` / `advisories` as JSON. No reader in either repository matches on `hint` text. The changeset states FROM → TO.

## Tests

Every heavy run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (slot `issue-22161-s17`).

- **The rule's own suite pins the new shape.** `validate-widget-bindings.test.ts` gains a slice-17 block. It records every finding of the 11 ids the file fires, and holds every recorded `fix:` line to one line of at most 200 characters with none of the moved clauses (`suppressWarnings`, `Object fields:`, `Fields on "`, `Declared include paths`, the old declared-list spellings). A coverage control names every id and every multi-arm hint (dashboard filter dotted / explicit / inherited; chart x-axis / y-axis / series / declared-but-unselected; measures with and without dimensions). Exact pins read the three-name bound with its ellipsis, the no-measures wording, and both legacy lines; a check per id asserts that `explainRule(id)` holds what the line stopped saying.
- **Lint suite**: base `086fa4640` Test Files 139 passed (139), Tests 6,738 passed, 5 skipped; branch `efc9582c3` 139 / 6,754 passed, 5 skipped; VERDICT command-exit 0 both; at the final head `33460e98b` (after the merge and the fix below, lint rebuilt) Test Files 139 passed (139), Tests 6,759 passed, VERDICT 0.
- **Census over the whole lint suite**: base 231 ids fire, 44 with a hint over 200; this head 231 ids, 33 over 200. The difference is exactly these 11.
- **Typecheck and build**: the CLI closure build at `efc9582c3`, and again a lint build at the final head `33460e98b`, and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck` OK, 2 files / 6 errors / 2 pinned signatures held), VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **CLI unit tier** (`--project unit`): Test Files 289 passed (289), Tests 4,317 passed, VERDICT 0; none of the 11 ids fires there.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`**: Test Files 236 passed, 3 skipped (239), Tests 28,409 / after the merge 28,412 passed, 19 skipped, VERDICT 0; only `dashboard-filter-field-unknown` fires there (140 characters after; the probe above carries FROM).
- **`@objectstack/spec` `test:repo`**: its first run at the merge head turned `retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts` red (3 failed of 1,033). The `os migrate meta` sentence moved into `chart-field-unknown`'s entry was split across two literals and was not the house sentence. It is now the house sentence in one plain-quoted literal, and that test file passes (15 / 15). At the final head `33460e98b` the whole project: Test Files 61 passed (61), Tests 1,033 passed, VERDICT 0.
- **`os validate`** (built CLI) on `app-crm`, `app-todo`, `app-showcase` and `app-multi-package`: exit 0 each, 9 / 7 / 68 / 3 `rule:` lines, and none of the 11 ids fires on any of them, so the apps' output is unaffected by this slice. `app-showcase` first exited 1 before any rule ran (`Cannot find module …connector-slack/dist`: an unbuilt dependency, not a verdict); it passed after a locked build of its closure.
- **Ablation**: one-shot, from the committed head `baa3efa02`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under the lock, with a shell `trap` restoring `HEAD` by absolute path. The rule suite imports the rule source, so there is no dist leg.
  - Mutation: `table-count-only`'s hint gains back its suppression and ADR-0017 tail (anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1, blob `d5b1b5debf34` → `f9431ca5f49a`).
  - Predicted before the run: exactly two cases red (the table-count-only exact-line pin, and the slice-17 bound case).
  - Observed: Tests 2 failed, 176 passed (178), exactly those two.
  - Restored: blob `d5b1b5debf34` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty.
- **ESLint, narrowed**: `npx eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the three changed `.ts` files: 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so no untouched file's verdict can move. A control-character scan of every changed file found no match.
- **Gates**: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths: 62 derived at the final head `33460e98b` (4 paths vs merge base `252775d1d`), each run with its exit code captured before any pipe: all 62 exit 0, `check:type-check-debt` included. `--ran`: "62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 62 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". The artifact-roster and PR-context families are CI's. At `baa3efa02` all 62 exited 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after a first refusal (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: unbuilt dists, while another locked build was running) and a rerun.
- **Merge**: `origin/main` merged once through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, without conflict, no regeneration owed (the branch edits no generated artifact; `main` brought `packages/cli`, `packages/metadata-protocol` and `packages/spec` test changes, no `packages/lint` file).

## Acceptance notes

- **The bounded declared-name clause** on the three empty-selection ids is the one place this slice keeps a list. No "Did you mean" covers it, and the names are the remedy's argument. If the ruling is a bare remedy, dropping it is a one-line change per id.
- **A long name can still lengthen a line.** The names in a hint are the author's: the dashboard filter, the object, the dataset, the relationship prefix, the field, the widget type. The closest measured case is `dashboard-filter-field-unprovisioned` at 177 (the shared anchor fix with the object and column names).
- **Some hints lose a clue a short list gave.** Where no near miss exists, the old field-existence lines listed what exists and the new ones name the remedy only. That is the earlier slices' rule.
- **Census blind spot**: the census preload records finding-shaped objects pushed onto arrays. Three `data-model-rules.ts` ids slice 16 listed (`object/missing-name-field`, `rollup/non-numeric-aggregand`, `field/select-missing-options`) do not appear in this census at the base or at the head, so their current lengths are NOT MEASURED here.
